competences.description: Hits the enemy with an Energy blast and inflicts Continuous Damage for 3 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Strikes the enemy with an attack strong enough to split the Earth, inflicting significant damage that ignores the enemy's Defense. Recovers the Attack Bar by 30% if the enemy gets defeated by this skill.

effets.description: Attack will ignore the target's defense.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Puts the enemy in an ice prison, freezes the enemy for 2 turns and absorbs the Attack Bar by 30%.

effets.description: Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself
The target will be frozen and won't be able to attack.
